title: TH vs S
tip: For /θ/, gently place your tongue between your teeth and let air pass. For /s/, keep your tongue behind your teeth.

title: R vs L
tip: For /l/, touch the ridge behind your upper teeth with your tongue. For /r/, pull the tongue back without touching the roof of your mouth.

title: V vs W
tip: For /v/, touch your upper teeth to your lower lip. For /w/, round your lips without touching your teeth.

title: Short I vs Long EE
tip: /ɪ/ is relaxed and short; /iː/ is tenser and usually longer.

title: B vs P
tip: /b/ is voiced. /p/ is voiceless and often has a puff of air at the start of a stressed syllable.
